name: Asano Azami
source: A 17 year old third year student, popular with the student body for her charm, elegance, and intellect. When not leading the mock trial club, she spends her time helping fellow students and looking after her younger sister. Although her responsibilities have distanced her from her sister in their personal life, she seems to wish to be a part of her life while she still has the chance.
